chars.GRANDMA: GRANDMA: a small hunched old woman in a deep green velvet djellaba, a white headscarf with gold trim, many silver bracelets, leaning on a wooden cane.
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a young man in a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.MOM: MOM: a middle-aged woman in a burgundy home kaftan with a beige headscarf and a white apron.
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young woman in a light blue hijab and a long cream knitted cardigan over a grey dress.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside an old dim Moroccan traditional house with zellige tiles, GRANDMA sits on a low sedari cushion and secretly drops dark powder into a smoking clay incense burner, thick mysterious smoke rising, small glass jars and a brass tray around her, she glances sideways suspiciously.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A modern Moroccan living room in Casablanca with sedari sofas and a tea tray: MOM leans toward NARRATOR and whispers a secret with one hand next to her mouth, NARRATOR sits beside her with wide surprised eyes.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Outside the blue wooden door of an old house in a narrow Moroccan medina alley, a line of several veiled neighbour women wait nervously holding small bags, GRANDMA stands in the doorway waving the next one in.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A cosy modern Moroccan apartment kitchen: NARRATOR and WIFE laugh together while drinking mint tea at a small table, normal happy married life, warm light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A flashback in an old traditional Moroccan courtyard house: GRANDMA braids the headscarf of a little girl version of WIFE (a small girl in a light blue dress) sitting in front of her, a smoking incense burner and strange herb bundles beside them.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night on a Moroccan apartment balcony with city lights: NARRATOR stands alone leaning on the railing, holding his chin, looking back through the glass door into the dark flat with a suspicious worried face.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan bedroom at night lit by a phone flashlight: NARRATOR kneels and quickly pulls open the drawers of a wooden dresser, clothes spilling out, he looks over his shoulder at the closed door nervously.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The same dark Moroccan bedroom: NARRATOR stands on a small stool and reaches with one hand behind the top of a tall wooden wardrobe into the dark shadow, holding a phone flashlight in the other hand, tense curious face, we cannot see what is up there.
